name: Corrupting Duality
body:
School necromancy; Level cabalist 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) Area 15-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half or Will half, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cannot cast this spell if you are not in either the formless body or opened mind binding.

A yellowish haze floods the targeted area, withering the bodies and minds of those within before vanishing without a trace. If you are in formless body binding, each creature takes 1d8 Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution damage (Fortitude half). If you are in the opened mind binding, each creature takes 1d8 Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma damage, instead (Will half).
